The plugin doesn't control physical machines yet, but Anthropic is separately developing the Model Hardware Standard for that. The article Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows appeared first on The Decoder ."}, {"id": "a5", "source": "The Decoder", "titre": "Nearly 70 percent of US agencies use generative AI, and unions are finally catching up with guardrails", "resume": "US public-sector unions are increasingly pushing through protections against AI surveillance and automated firings. In Oakland, a strike vote forced retraining programs instead of layoffs, and a transport union in Ohio won veto power over autonomous vehicles. California banned so-called bossware.
